$semantics.rows: Spending Tracker!M17 =SUM(N17:Y18), N17 =Jan!$C$19 .. Y17 =Dec!$C$19, and C19 =E21, the Bills block's Actual; M20 reads I19 (Debts) and M23 N19 (Subscriptions) the same way. So each is a twelve-month total of one group's Actual over the 2026 month tabs, a Year starting 2026-01.
$semantics.gate: F10. Spending Tracker never gates planned amounts, as the month tabs never do. asOf is 2026-12, so every month of the Year counts its plan and the Year's gate lets all twelve through.
$semantics.actuals: F3/D5, as in workbook-month part 2. M20 is Credit Card 1's planned 50 in eleven months and 700 in February 2026, where Student Loan's logged 650 has no plan to replace. The 2025 log rows fall outside the Year.
$semantics.planHistory: D13. The workbook's one Monthly Amount serves every tab; each is typed here as a row from 2025-01, as in workbook-month parts 2 and 3.
$semantics.signs: D3: logged payments are positive in Bills!Q and negated in the ledger.
$semantics.left out: Spending Tracker!M26 (Variable expenses, 0): the month tabs' Transactions-driven Actuals are 0 for any engine (plan section 5.4).
